trash-bag.weightReason: Published full weight five pounds minus explicitly five pounds of trash equals zero separately counted empty weight. Do not add the mundane Sack’s weight.

animate-wand-bracers.review: Empty wrist-worn native container; add actual owned wands separately. Drawing and stowing a stored wand is mentally directed and free even outside your turn. Source refers to a normal wand bracer without giving a numeric capacity; none is invented. PF1 container sheets do not expose activation actions, so retrieval remains a manual inventory procedure. Illustrated wands are examples, not bundled contents.

bandolier-of-grenades.review: Five empty object slots, one suitably shaped alchemical creation, dust, oil or potion each; retrieve one as a move action. Slot count is not a weight capacity. No consumables are bundled. Bomb generation begins only at the separate 6th-level 4800 gp upgrade; higher damage/price tiers are not active in this base variant. Transient bombs cannot be stockpiled or passed along; no unlimited grenade inventory or attack is granted.

bottomless-flask.review: Empty two-pound container with five separate twenty-gallon extradimensional spaces. Twist the stopper as a swift action to select a space; pour at most one pint or one alchemical flask per round into a square within reach. Liquids remain separated, including volatile substances; breaking the flask loses all contents. Gallons are not converted to a guessed pound capacity. Compartment choice, volume and pouring are manual; the source gives no explicit carried-weight exemption, so automatic weight reduction remains deferred. No nested compartments or liquids are fabricated.

keyhome.review: Empty native container for actual stored objects. A standard action opens or closes a ten-foot-square doorway to ten contiguous ten-foot cubes whose arrangement is fixed when crafted. Contents persist with the key. Preserve the source Strength DC twenty-five / Escape Artist DC thirty exit rules, incoming air and forty-to-ninety Fahrenheit limits. Room layout, occupants, doorway movement and environmental influence remain manual. No fabricated room scene, nested compartments, pound limit or automatic weight exemption.

medic-satchel.review: One supply bundle inside the white satchel tracks ten uses of a healer's kit, not ten physical bandages. The base grants +2 circumstance to Heal when appropriately using the kit and counts as a healer's kit. At the beginning of each day, or after manually spending one actual spell point for an instantaneous full refill, restore its contained counter to ten. Refill remains manual and bag-dependent; loose supplies do not automatically regenerate. No blanket Heal modifier, upgraded bonus, faster recharge or unlimited-use tier is active. The listed price and full one-pound weight are counted once on the parent; separate supply weights/values are unspecified and need manual allocation if split away.
medic-satchel.allocationReason: Published full one-pound weight and 250-gp value are recorded once on the satchel. The source specifies ten kit uses but no separate supply mass/value; child zeroes are included accounting, not a weightless-supplies ruling. Reallocate manually if separated.

pocket-of-holding.review: Empty hand-sized cloth bag or sewn-in pocket. Track both the one-cubic-foot and ten-pound storage limits; do not convert volume to an invented larger weight capacity. No contents are bundled. The source does not explicitly state a carried-weight exemption, so no automatic weight reduction is borrowed from a conventional Bag of Holding.

quill-of-endless-ink.review: The metal carrying case itself is mundane; the one contained feather quill is CL one Creation. Two positions remain empty. The published eighty-gp package value is allocated to its quill, with no additional case price or non-negligible weight invented. The quill writes continuously without dripping and uses one ink type. Special ink requires five vials when crafting a special-ink quill; no special ink or extra quills are supplied.
quill-of-endless-ink.allocationReason: The listed eighty-gp magical quill carries the package value; its usual included mundane case has zero incremental assigned value. Both are negligible weight as published. CL 1 Creation belongs to the quill, not its emptied CL 0 case.
